title: George Boole: 211 Years Ago Today, a Shoemaker's Son Wrote Computer Logic

lines: A shoemaker's son wrote the language of computers.
Who changed the world today? November 2.
Who changed the world today? November second.

He taught at a school by day

In eighteen fifty-four, he published The Laws of Thought,

He believed human reasoning could be written as equations.
True and false became one and zero,
and words like "and", "or" and "not"
became things you could calculate.
